title: Retrieval plan
description: A retrieval plan authored by the LLM planner: an intent plus tool-call steps that the agent (pure code) validates and executes. Step args may embed reference strings of the form $steps[<id>].<path>, resolved at execution time against stored step results. The path language is exactly: dotted field access, [n] index, and [*] fan-out — no other expressions. A [*] that resolves to a list fans the step out into one tool call per value, capped at PLAN_MAX_FANOUT (excess truncated and noted in the step summary); multiple [*] in one path flatten into ONE flat value list; a path resolving to zero values completes the step with empty results and zero tool calls. Referencing a fanned-out step: $steps[N] denotes the ordered list of that step's per-call results, and further path segments apply across the list with the same flatten rule. This schema is STRUCTURAL only. Enforced in code by the agent's validator, not here: step-id uniqueness, tool existence in the session's per-user tools/list, per-tool argument validation (structural tool schemas + observed-enum membership), depends_on/reference consistency and acyclicity, and the PLAN_MAX_STEPS budget.

intent.description: One-sentence statement of what the plan retrieves, in terms of the user's question.

steps.description: Tool-call steps, executed in dependency order. Deliberately no maxItems: the PLAN_MAX_STEPS limit is an env-configured validation budget enforced in code (exceeding it is a plan_invalid validation failure, never budget_exceeded).

id.description: Step identifier, unique within the plan (uniqueness checked in code).

tool.description: Name of an MCP tool present in THIS session's tools/list. A tool the user cannot access fails plan validation before anything executes.

args.description: Arguments for the tool, validated in code against the tool's structural JSON Schema plus observed-enum membership. Any string value may be a $steps[<id>].<path> reference (see the root description for the full reference syntax).

reason.description: Why this step is needed for the intent.

depends_on.description: Ids of steps whose results this step references. Must be consistent with the $steps references in args; the dependency graph must be acyclic (both checked in code).
